blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur—Anti-narcotics operatives arrested a 27-year-old man and seized approximately 100 grams of suspected “shabu” (crystal meth) worth P680,000. The apprehension happened during a buy-bust operation in Zamboanga City on Thursday night, Nov. 12. Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA) Region 9 Director Bryan Babang identified the suspect only as alias “Kol,” married, and a resident of Barangay Sta. Barbara, Zamboanga City. Operatives from PDEA-9 Zamboanga City Office, Zamboanga City Police Office–City Drug Enforcement Unit and Police Regional Mobile Force Battalion 9 conducted the sting at around 8:40 p.m. along Don Alfaro Street in Barangay Tetuan.
